cross_references.note: Greenman strict liability (tort) and §2314 implied warranty (contract) are concurrent theories; Greenman intentionally separated from warranty; both may be pled simultaneously.
§2314 warranty breach SOL is COM §2725 (4-year from delivery); CCP §338(d) fraud SOL (3-year from discovery) is an alternative if seller committed fraud in connection with the warranty.
RedJag VEH §11713 dealer fraud runs concurrent with §2314 implied warranty breach. §11713(u) (wrong CARFAX) = §2314(2)(a)/(f) failure. Both theories available against the dealer.
VIN tampering (VEH §10751) makes vehicle not fit for ordinary purposes (§2314(2)(c)) — vehicle cannot be lawfully titled/registered with tampered VIN. §2314 breach follows §10751 violation.
CIV §1572 actual fraud vitiates 'as is' warranty disclaimers under COM §2316. Dealer cannot use 'as is' to disclaim liability for fraudulent concealment of VIN tampering and wrong CARFAX.
Rees-Levering governs the yo-yo financing fraud component of RedJag. §2314 governs the vehicle's physical condition and title. Different theories, same transaction.
